meta.author:
Horatio Gates Spafford, Kristene DiMarco, Philip Paul Bliss
中文翻譯：天堂敬拜

lines.a: 大地都曾經震動  因祂聲音顫抖
lines.b: Grander earth has quaked before, moved by the sound of His voice

lines.a: 大海洶湧風浪翻騰  因我仰望祢而平息
lines.b: Seas that are shaken and stirred, can be calmed and broken for my regard

lines.a: 帶領我 帶領我 眼光專注祢
lines.b: And through it all, through it all, my eyes are on You

lines.a: 帶領我 帶領我 得安息
lines.b: And through it all, through it all, it is well

lines.a: 帶領我 帶領我 眼光專注祢
lines.b: And through it all, through it all, my eyes are on You
And it is well with me

lines.a: 雖我眼還未看見  我心卻不懷疑
lines.b: And far be it from me to not believe, even when my eyes can't see

lines.a: 即使大山在我面前  祢能挪移投進海裡
lines.b: And this mountain that's in front of me, will be thrown into the midst of the sea

lines.a: 我靈交託  堅定相信
lines.b: So let go my soul and trust in Him
The waves and wind still know His name
